profile_text.body:
Equifax Inc. is a credit bureau that, in its own description, provides credit reports and credit scores to businesses and consumers, along with identity protection tools offering daily monitoring and alerts. The company markets Equifax Complete, a monitoring product, and says its dedicated ID Restoration Specialists work on a customer's behalf to help recover from identity theft. Its site also publishes consumer education material on credit reports, credit scores, debt, credit cards, loans, and fraud, including Spanish-language resources covering Equifax credit reports in the United States.

The harvested site text describes no AI products or services, and nothing in the material positions the company in AI markets. Its stated focus is credit reporting, credit monitoring, and identity protection.

Equifax Inc. is a for-profit public company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, trading under the ticker EFX, with SEC CIK 0000033185. Its legal exposure is recorded in Georgia, with a count of 105. No lawsuits against the company are listed.
